test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All cups are bottles.

2. All bottles are pans.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cups are pans.

II. All bottles are cups.

III. All pans are cups.

IV. Some pans are bottles.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and IV follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d311011dcd5fb97d16bbc4da0b00f1ad6a1e504c02d570b62d7c19390d318875.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All cups are pans. → **Follows** (As, All cups are bottles and All bottles are pans, So the conclusion definitely follows.)

II. All bottles are cups. → Does not follow (As, All cups are bottles → Some bottles are cups)

III. All pans are cups. → Does not follow (As, All cups are bottles and All bottles are pans → Some pans are cups)

IV. Some pans are bottles. →** Follows** (As, All bottles are pans, So the conclusion definitely follows.)

Hence, **only conclusions I and IV follow**.
